summary: Change Agents Corporation (CHGA) filed an 8-K reporting the September 30, 2026 issuance of a second tranche of OID notes to accredited investors. The registrant issued notes with an aggregate principal amount of $336,000, inclusive of a $36,000 original issue discount, for gross proceeds of $300,000. Net proceeds were used to repay $125,000 of 18.75% June 2025 notes, $125,000 owed to a Series F Preferred holder under redemption provisions, and a $37,125 installment to its lead lender. Investors also received pre-funded warrants for 100,000 shares at $0.0001 per share. The notes mature April 30, 2027, bear 7% interest (15% upon default), and include negative covenants, an MFN provision, and a ban on variable rate transactions. This is a routine financing and liability management transaction, not a special situation.
